question.problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}3 & -2 \\ -2 & 5\end{aligned}]
$$

Given the matrix $A$ above, evaluate the quadratic form $Q(x)={x}^{T}\,Ax$ when $x=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
Substituting $x=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]$ into the expression for $Q(x),$ we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}Q(x) & ={x}^{T}\,Ax \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}3 & -2 \\ -2 & 5\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5 & -7\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =12.\end{aligned}
$$
